<thought>Carbon shows the characteristic ~1.003 Da spacing with a ~10 % M+1 peak, matching its natural ^13C abundance. The relatively elevated M+2 intensity compared to a pure carbon pattern suggests an element with a notable +2 isotope, most consistent with sulfur (^34S, 4.2 %). No chlorine or bromine patterns are present. Therefore, carbon and sulfur can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'S']</final_answer>
